# The five OECD principles and the curation of the data (generated by `cypmode/challenge/oecd_principles.py`)

Each cell is read from a file of the project or computed by the module; the sources are named in the last column. The cross-validated numbers are estimates on the training data and not scores on the hidden labels, except where a row says that it reads the released labels.

Abbreviations: AUC, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve; AUPRC, area under the precision–recall curve; ECFP4, extended-connectivity fingerprints of diameter 4; MCC, Matthews correlation coefficient; TDI, time-dependent inhibition; z0, the cut on the confidence of the label (1.0 or 1.96).

| principle | isoform | evidence | source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1. A defined endpoint | CYP3A4 | time-dependent inhibition of CYP3A4: positive when the pIC50 after pre-incubation exceeds the direct-inhibition pIC50 (floored at 4) by more than log10 2; the rule gives the given label for 2334 of 2334 compounds of the pool and for all 747 of the 750 released test labels for which both potencies are given (0 disagree, 3 cannot be computed). | audit section 4; tdi_targets.py; post_deadline tdi_question2a_agreement.csv |
| 2. An unambiguous algorithm | CYP3A4 | 28 members (default+all_survivors), a logistic blend of the inner out-of-fold scores with the penalty and its strength chosen on the inner folds, isotonic calibration, a call rate of 1.3 times the prevalence; every member, column set, hyperparameter, seed, and package version is in algorithm_manifest.json; the code is open, and each submitted file has a SHA-256 hash. | algorithm_manifest.json; manifest.json; nested_runners.py; final_tdi_build.py |
